label: Shadow the Hedgehog
description: The ultimate life form, brooding his way to your destination.
direction: Speak in Shadow the Hedgehog's low, cool, brooding voice: serious, confident, terse, a little aloof, as if every drive is a grave mission. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Sonic Adventure 2 (2001 video game) and later Sonic the Hedgehog games and media
rights.author: Sega (character created by Sonic Team)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 2001 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and the character is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known catchphrases and personality; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Sonic the Hedgehog name, which are live Sega trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Hmph. Not far for me.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I could run there faster. Keep driving.
lines.start_drive_1: Hmph. I am the ultimate life form. And your navigator.
lines.start_drive_2: Shadow here. Don't slow me down.
lines.start_drive_3: Let's get this over with. I have Chaos Emeralds to find.
lines.start_drive_4: This is my mission now. Drive, and don't ask questions.
lines.start_drive_5: Sonic would get lost. I won't. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_6: Buckle up. I don't intend to lose.
lines.start_drive_7: I keep my promises. I'll get you there. Move.
lines.start_drive_8: The road ahead is clear. For now. Let's ride.
lines.start_drive_9: No time for small talk. Hit the road.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Hmph. A minor setback.
lines.arrived: We've arrived. Mission complete. Don't thank me.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Don't fall behind.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Keep your head in the game.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Chaos, control yourself.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Pathetic. I'd be there by now.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Stay alert. This is no game.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Even I obey the limit here.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. That's an order.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Stay calm. I have dealt with far worse.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. Chaos Control! There. New route.
